list.title: Return Authorizations
list.description: Authorize customer returns, receive goods, inspect each line and record its disposition.

workflow.title: Return workflow
workflow.requested: Record the quantities received from the customer, or reject this request with a reason.
workflow.inspection: Choose how many received units to accept and where accepted goods should go.
workflow.completed: Inspection completed and customer credit issued
workflow.awaitingApproval: Inspection is recorded; the customer credit is awaiting approval.
workflow.reasonPlaceholder: Explain why the return is rejected
workflow.emailFailed: Could not send the return update
